invariants.statement: The deterministic catalog contains exactly 40 records: one Deep Learning Specialization, its five linked component courses, and 34 additional classified offline records.
Every catalog result carries the complete detail and source-evidence classification required by browse, search, filtering, detail, preview, pricing, and enrollment views.
Catalog reset atomically replaces mutations with the canonical 40 records and consecutive resets produce identical ordered state.
Every clone runtime path is same-origin and produces zero remote requests and zero production effects.
acceptance_obligations: Run current static and live diagnostics and inspect network closure for the frozen route/state matrix.

invariants.statement: Accounts, sessions, mail, payment flows, business state, database file, and volume identity remain bound to site_id 33 through the generated WebsiteBench integration seam.
acceptance_obligations: Exercise applicable backend and cross-site isolation tests before completion of the full clone.

invariants.statement: Authenticated source behavior is never represented as directly observed; all dashboard, learning, history, preference, account mutation, recovery-mail, and checkout behavior is labeled unavailable source evidence plus deterministic clone-local simulation.
acceptance_obligations: Review trace bindings, source-evidence classifications, and visible simulation labels.

invariants.statement: Paid enrollment accepts only the generated local-sandbox adapter and opaque scenario IDs; no card, bank, wallet, provider token, Stripe credential, or live payment data enters the clone.
acceptance_obligations: Exercise approval, decline, retry, duplicate, stale fingerprint, amount tampering, and foreign-owner behavior through the generated runtime before full-clone completion.

invariants.statement: No-results, required-field, signed-out, support, and not-found states preserve a safe route back to browse or the relevant local collection and expose no private data.
acceptance_obligations: Walk every recovery checkpoint and inspect navigation, status, and visible privacy boundaries.
